payload.claim: test_a_stack_batch_refuses_every_descendant_of_a_task_that_missed_review only checks that the refusal line for a grandchild (e.g. TE-13) contains the ultimate missed spec's id and lacks the layer's id, never that it excludes the intermediate refused spec (TE-12) that sits between them. Changing line 306 from `found |= reaches[entry]` to `found |= reaches[entry] | {entry}` makes a refused spec's own id leak into its descendants' reason lines (e.g. TE-13's line would name both TE-11 and TE-12, even though TE-12 never ran), yet every assertion in the test still passes because it only checks `"TE-11" in refused["TE-13"]` and `"TE-14" not in refused["TE-13"]`. This violates the acceptance criterion that the line names only specs that 'ran and missed', and the gates cannot see it because they only run the existing (too-loose) test.
